info.description: DRAFT frontend/backend handoff, 18 October 2026. No service deployed. All private resources derive ownership from validated bearer subject, never arbitrary client userId. Immutable completion ledger prevents duplicate reward. Direct Gemini remains a separate client adapter. Current lesson rollout: Biology/Chemistry/Physics; six other subject modules are framework-only. First completion of each stable unit awards 200/400 XP; genuine retakes award zero XP but may light daily streak.

post.description: UNIQUE(attempt_id) completion ledger. Same idempotency key and body returns original award; mismatched body returns 409. Server validates completion and review coverage, computes day/timezone and EXP, and commits completion/reward/streak/daily aggregate in one transaction. A retry must never grant twice. clientCompletedAt is advisory, not ranking authority. Reward ledger additionally has UNIQUE(user_id, subject_id, grade, reward_unit_id). Stable rewardUnitId survives unenroll/re-enroll and minor curriculum revisions. A new genuine retake attempt returns xpAwarded=0 and may light a new day streak. Reopening/replaying an old attempt completion cannot light another day streak. firstRewardForUnit indicates whether the award was newly granted.

get.description: No individual-level ranking. FRIENDS includes only accepted friends and self. Server defines day/timezone and deterministic tie policy. No client-supplied EXP, rank or day used as authority. Initial learning-day policy is Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh for every learner, profile dailyXp and ranking, so compared XP uses the same time window. Client cannot set this timezone.

post.description: Maximum 4 MiB per file. AVATAR only accepts supported image MIME types and decoded image content. CHAT accepts supported images, PDF and plain text. Validate actual content, not only the supplied name/MIME. Signed download URLs are short-lived and never public storage ACLs.

get.summary: Authenticated SSE invalidations, replayable by event cursor
get.description: SSE id is eventId; data is ChangeEvent JSON. Emit after committed writes, scoped to ownership/public subscriptions. Client ignores older resource revisions and refetches resource via authorized API; deletes are tombstones. 410 means full resync. Send heartbeat comments, reconnect with jitter, cancel on logout. Do not include private message text or API keys in ranking/public-profile events.
